OneLineDescription: Forwards CELL headers from a configurable lighting mod or the last override that directly masters it.
LongDescription: For every CELL overridden by the selected lighting mod, forwards only the CELL record/header from the highest-priority override whose plugin directly lists that lighting mod as a master. If no such override exists, the selected lighting mod itself is used. LAND, NAVM, persistent/temporary placed records, and CELL child groups are not forwarded.
